scientific_integrity: An analytical all-even-order proof and finite numerical corroboration are supplied. Previously known Weyl diagonalization and prime-order and rank formulas are credited. Same-model review only.
scientific_limitations: Even cyclic lengths N>=6, one-site complex-defect family only; no global window optimality, full-spark claim, nonlinear inverse stability, or independent audit. Older unindexed equivalent minimax remains possible.
title: Sharp even-order conditioning for one-impulse cyclic Gabor tomography
